title: PK DOCUMENT TRACKING SYSTEM / PROPOSED PROCESS FLOW

pages.title: Proposed request preparation and submission
pages.subprocess: 1. Prepare, save and submit a request

steps.description: Choose a request action, enter its details and select Save Draft.
Validate fields, permission, ownership and active targets; save a valid draft.
Reopen the saved draft; review the proposal and required Document File.
Submit the saved proposal for its configured approval route.
Capture the published route and version; activate the first step; mark Submitted.

notes: Softcopy Create/Revise need a Document File before submission: PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG/JPEG, DOCX or XLSX; maximum 15 MB.
Only the requester may edit Draft/Returned proposals. Access and assignment requests name that requester as recipient.
Cancel applies only to Drafts; owner-only Delete applies to eligible Cancelled drafts with no submission or workflow state.
Access expiry must be after today when saved and remain valid at final approval.
A Submitted access, assignment or transfer request blocks another of these for the same requester and document.
Hardcopy updates require the current holder or an Administrator.
legend: Softcopy Create registers a controlled record/file; Revise publishes a replacement revision; Cancel marks Cancelled and retires files.
Hardcopy Create registers title, storage and holder; Update applies proposed metadata and retention information.
Access Grant provides time-limited access; Document Assignment adds a softcopy assignee or changes the hardcopy holder.
Hardcopy Transfer creates handoff work (sheet 3). Hardcopy Disposal marks Disposed, clears Location and revokes grants.

pages.title: Proposed approval and return process
pages.subprocess: 2. Review, decide and apply a request

steps.description: Submit a proposal and await the assigned review.
Present the active approval task to its assigned user or configured role.
Review the proposal, required pending file and decision history.
Choose Approve, Return or Reject; add an optional remark for Return or Reject.
Save the decision and history; continue, return or end the approval route.
On final approval, apply the operation; complete the request or prepare a transfer.

notes: Only the active step's assigned user or role member may decide. Types: user, role, Requester's leader or requester; resolved accounts must be active at submission.
Return after the first step will reopen the immediately preceding approved step. Return from the first step will send the proposal to its requester.
Resubmission will retain the captured approval route and preserve previous decision history. Rejection will end the request.
Final approval applies the operation atomically; failed checks save no decision. A transfer remains Approved until Dispatch and Accept complete.
legend: Approve: continue the configured route or apply the final operation.
Return: reopen the previous step or return to the requester.

pages.title: Proposed physical document transfer
pages.subprocess: 3. Approve, dispatch and accept a hardcopy

steps.description: Select an active hardcopy, recipient and different active destination; submit.
Review and approve the transfer through its configured approval route.
Prepare the For Transfer handoff; preserve the current holder and Location.
Dispatch the physical document and confirm its release.
Accept the in-transit document and confirm physical receipt.
Recheck the holder and approved destination; update custody and Location; complete the request.

notes: Only the original transfer requester will be allowed to Dispatch; this account may differ from the current holder. Only the designated recipient will be allowed to Accept.
Approval will prepare the handoff without moving custody. Dispatch will mark it In Transit; recipient acceptance will complete it.
Acceptance will require the active document, unchanged holder and approved active destination hierarchy. A failed check will preserve custody and location.
When custody changes to another user, acceptance will revoke the previous holder's personal hardcopy grants.
legend: For Transfer: approved handoff awaiting Dispatch.
In Transit: dispatched document awaiting recipient acceptance.
Accepted / Completed: receipt and custody update recorded.

pages.title: Proposed document use and direct maintenance
pages.subprocess: 4. Browse, use files and apply authorized direct actions

steps.description: Sign in, complete any required temporary-password setup, and open the Softcopy or Hardcopy catalog.
Apply role permissions and document scope to records and available actions.
For a softcopy, open, download or print its current controlled file when authorized.
Choose a permitted direct document maintenance or assignment action.
Validate the direct permission, document scope, active targets and proposed changes.
Apply the authorized changes immediately and save the controlled record.

notes: File access requires permission, document scope, an active record and its current approved file; catalog visibility alone is insufficient.
Direct actions need their own permission and apply without an approval request.
Assignments cover one record, a hardcopy Location or a softcopy category branch; bulk limit: 2,000 active records.
Hardcopy assignment changes Current Holder immediately, without Dispatch/Accept; softcopy assignment adds the user and keeps earlier assignees.
Active transfers block direct hardcopy reassignment. Expired or revoked grants confer no access.
legend: Direct Softcopy actions: Create, Revise, Cancel and Dispose.
Direct Hardcopy actions: Create, Update and Dispose.
Direct assignments: selected active document or permitted location/category group.

pages.title: Proposed administration, audit and recovery
pages.subprocess: 5. Maintain definitions and prepare controlled recovery

steps.description: Sign in and open the permitted system administration pages.
Maintain active user accounts, roles and delegated permissions.
Maintain the hardcopy place hierarchy and softcopy categories.
Clone and edit workflow drafts; publish the default approval route per request type.
Inspect audit records; create, download or import backups; clean up eligible old archives.
Verify the selected archive, password and RESTORE confirmation; create a recovery snapshot before restoring database and private data.

notes: Separate admin permissions; workflow changes preserve Submitted/Returned routes.
Backup needs encryption password, signing key, AES-256 ZIP and DB tools. Includes DB/code/private data; excludes sessions/cache/backups.
Restore checks archive/password/RESTORE, makes a recovery backup, restores DB/private data in maintenance, then signs out. Code recovery is offline.
Cleanup: eligible backup/audit/log archives older than 3 months.
legend: Places: Area > Specific > optional Asset > Location.
Categories: softcopy category and subcategory hierarchy.
Recovery: protected archive, verified contents and pre-restore snapshot.
